evidence.text: Program manager at Kinloch Software (field-service scheduling software), February 2021 to present, running the replacement of the in-house billing system with a vendor platform across engineering, finance and customer support.

Raised the March 2024 invoice-numbering conflict with the finance and engineering directors, set out two options with their cost and delay, and recorded the directors' decision and rationale in the programme decision log.
Tracked the vendor's contractual milestones and ran acceptance testing of each delivery against the agreed acceptance criteria, returning two deliveries with defect lists.

evidence.text: Planned three cutover rehearsals with finance operations, each with a timed runbook and a reconciliation of invoices between the old and new systems.
Reported spend against the programme budget each quarter from the finance system's cost-centre extract, splitting vendor fees, contractor days and internal engineering time.
evidence.notes: The candidate reported spend against the programme budget, but it is unclear if they tracked the programme budget against plan and forecasted the cost to completion.
